start_frame: The sh089 axis, now nailed down: Alice arriving at the little door with the low curtain hanging above her like a proscenium, both hands going to the leaf.
end_frame: The same frame as she hauls at it: shut again, shoulder-high to her at two feet, and not giving at all — discovery and defeat inside one frame.
constraint_honoured: 'Run and discovery of the shut door in one move, no second look back: discovery and defeat land in the same frame.'
movement_note: The travelling shot stops here rather than continuing into the door, so the cut from movement to stillness is what states the failure.
